summary: First full-stack test of Agentspace. Backend: 13/13 pytest tests PASS (auth, sessions CRUD, messages, SSE chat stream — Flash mode streamed actual deltas + done; Pro and Grounding hit Gemini free-tier RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED → friendly error SSE event as expected). Frontend: login page, workspace, sidebar, mode toggle, grounding toggle, command palette (Cmd+K), new workspace, chat send w/ live React preview, tab toggle, copy code button, and logout all work via injected test session cookie.

minor.issue: Gemini free-tier quota exhausted — returns friendly 'error' SSE event. Acceptable per requirements but Pro/Grounding paths could not be validated end-to-end with actual generation.

issues: a11y warning: DialogContent missing DialogTitle/Description (Radix). Console warning only — wrap with VisuallyHidden DialogTitle to silence.
Console warning: outdated JSX transform — recommend updating CRA Babel preset (cosmetic).

action_items: (Optional) Wrap cmdk CommandDialog content with a VisuallyHidden DialogTitle/Description to clear Radix a11y warnings.
(Optional) Document expected Gemini Pro/Grounding 429 behavior in UI more prominently — currently surfaces via error SSE event which Chat shows as assistant error bubble.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses `stream_gemini._emitted_gen` as a function attribute to track per-stream state — this is GLOBAL across requests and never reset. Will misbehave under concurrent users. Recommend moving to a local variable within stream_gemini.
server.py: synchronous `for chunk in stream` inside async generator blocks the event loop. Consider `asyncio.to_thread` or `run_in_executor` for the genai sync stream.
Login page document.title is still 'Emergent | Fullstack App' — should be 'Agentspace' for branding.
AuthContext fires /api/auth/me on /login route producing a 401 in console — could short-circuit when on /login path to reduce noise.
CORS allow_origin_regex='.*' combined with allow_credentials=True is overly permissive — consider restricting to known origins in production.
test_credentials: session_token=test_session_agentspace_001 (Bearer or cookie). User: test-user-agentspace / tester@agentspace.dev. Documented in /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
seed_data_creation: Used pre-seeded test session and user. Test created/renamed/deleted TEST_-prefixed chat sessions; all cleaned up via fixture teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers auth + sessions + SSE chat. Flash mode works reliably; Pro/Grounding may return friendly quota error — that's acceptable. For Playwright, inject session_token cookie (domain=ai-renderer-2.preview.emergentagent.com, httpOnly+secure+sameSite=None) BEFORE navigating to /workspace. All major data-testid attributes are present and reliable. Note: artifact-panel testid only shows when an artifact is rendered; before that, artifact-empty-state is shown.
rca of the issue: N/A — no blocking issues. Free-tier Gemini quota on Pro/Grounding paths is environmental, not a code bug, and is handled gracefully by the friendly-error SSE event branch in server.py:392-400.
